overview.description: The Texas Precious Metals Trust Y'all Street Physical Gold ETF (YSAU) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the LBMA Gold Price index. The fund tracks the gold spot price, less expenses, using physical gold bars held in a vault located in the US. YSAU was launched on Jul 15, 2026 and is issued by Yall Street.
